notes.note: The copyright footer has no fields: mod_footer draws two language strings. inlineMarkup.why: The stored value of these text fields carries markup around or between its words: an accent span or a line break in a heading, a styled unit span in a price, a paragraph wrapper around a body. This version of the block store format does not describe that markup, so it is declared here as one class with owners instead of being modelled field by field.

owners.#585: how a value that carries inline markup is written (which wrapper and which inner element keep the template's look; the mapping file of #584 gives each such field the location of its stored element and leaves the markup to this ticket), and the gate that catches a broken look when such a value is written as plain words

fields.note: Running rich text, not a child list: each step's stored value is a body, one paragraph followed by a highlight list (ul.list-highlight, five lines in each of the four stored values), and its limit was measured on that whole body. The list is a part of the body's markup, kept with the paragraph by the owners of this class, not a list of rows of the step.

Running rich text, not a child list: the trainer's stored biography is one paragraph followed by a highlight list (ul.list-highlight h4, four lines), and its limit was measured on that whole body. The list is a part of the body's markup, kept with the paragraph by the owners of this class, not a list of rows of the trainer.
